hypotheses.R1_local_optimization_improves_validatio: At least one local learning rate improves interleaved FineWeb validation KL by at least 2% for every family/rank pair.
hypotheses.R2_rank20_gain_survives_external_data: The validation-selected rank-20 basis improves median KL by at least 5% over its PCA initialization on every corpus for both global and anchored families.
hypotheses.R3_rank68_reaches_near_sufficiency: At least one validation-selected rank-68 basis reaches median KL at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_behavior_fit_trades_away_variance: At least one selected basis lowers held-out KL while capturing less write variance than its initialization on every corpus.
hypotheses.R5_anchor_is_not_costly: The selected anchored basis has no more than 10% higher median KL than the selected global basis at each rank and corpus.
